issue.title: Mods can no longer override textures/media based on load order (devtest error)

pull_request.body_normalized: Fixes #12557. Ruben replaced a [reverse iterator (`crbegin` & `crend`)](https://github.com/minetest/minetest/commit/06de82fd86678e0a1c260c67792c5cd192863edd#diff-24cd186c8d4fc53d29afe3e5c3b0a1c53fe9418edfb702996fc9a0ffdbbfa051L99) with a normal one. Reverted that and added a comment since this is a reregression (the second time mod media overriding was broken) so that this doesn't happen again.
